title: Insertion sort: trace and implement
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: Choose the model answer: What is [5,2,4] after one complete ascending bubble-sort pass?
Choose the model answer: What is the value of i after i++ when i was 2?
Choose the model answer: Is a stack FIFO or LIFO?
Choose the model answer: What change makes bubble sort terminate early on sorted data?

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: key — Value being inserted into the sorted prefix.
sorted prefix — Initial segment already placed in order.
shift — Move a value one index to create space.
in-place — Uses little additional data storage.
stable — Equal elements can preserve relative order.

blocks.title: One key at a time
blocks.text: The prefix to the left of i is already sorted; take a[i] as the key.

blocks.title: Make room
blocks.text: Shift larger values in the sorted prefix one position to the right.

blocks.title: Insert the key
blocks.text: Place it at j+1; the sorted prefix grows by one element.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model solution
blocks.text: Shift 8 then 4 to the right and insert 1 at index 0 → [1,4,8,6].
